resources.string: Only while the GPS is lost in a known tunnel, the accelerometer tells a stopped car from a moving one, so the position estimate does not drift in a queue. Nothing is stored or sent.
Show distance in the status bar
On Android 16 and later, the distance to the next turn appears as a chip in the status bar while you navigate. You can also turn promoted notifications off for this app in the system settings.
Hide the status bar while navigating
The notification icons of other apps stay out of sight on the navigation screen. Swipe down from the top edge to see the bar for a moment. Off by default.

Android does not let an app block other apps\' pop-ups. To avoid them while driving, set up a Do Not Disturb mode that allows calls (Settings, Do Not Disturb, People, Calls: Everyone) and turn it on when you drive.
